matching: same-class descending IoU greedy; ties opaque IDs; one-to-one
merge_split_diagnostic: intersection over enclosed region area >=0.5; never additional TP
coordinate_space: raster_pixel top-left xyxy; no PDF point conversion
content_scoring: confirmed-reference presence; PP localized parsing blocks, Ovis page presence only; formula candidates not counted again
order_scoring: paragraph same-class IoU>=0.50 anchor matching; null order remains missing
uncertain_policy: excluded from exact GT denominator; no current-model-derived annotation

monkey.prompt: Please output the categories and coordinates of the document elements in reading order.

ovis.prompt: Extract readable content in reading order as Markdown. Preserve original text, numbers, units and symbols. Do not translate, correct, summarize or infer.

unspecified_parameters: service defaults, identical across formats; temperature omitted as in accepted T0015
pp_scope: aggregate Pipeline only; record model_settings; no independent submodel claims
input_limit: JPEG-decoded PNG cannot restore previously lost detail; not electronic PDF validation
